data.name: Jamshaid
data.gender_notes: Jamshaid is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jamshaid is a Persian-origin name that means 'Radiant King' or 'Shining Monarch'. It is linked to ancient Persian mythology and Islamic heritage. The name Jamshaid carries the meaning “Bright, Shining King” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Jamshaid usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, shining king and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes enlightenment, divine leadership, and moral strength, often attributed to wisdom in kingship.
data.etymology: Jamshaid belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bright, Shining King.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jamshaid total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
